paragraphs.chinese:
这一集讨论的是，人到底能不能真正改变。没有人彻底变成另一个人，但其中几个人确实做出了一点点变化，而这已经足够了。

杰和几个老朋友吃午饭时遇到了卡梅隆。他没有把卡梅隆介绍成米切尔的伴侣，只说他是“我儿子的一个朋友”。米切尔很难过，因为他和卡梅隆已经在一起五年，还共同抚养着一个女儿。

米切尔去质问杰，杰却说自己的朋友不会理解。为了让父亲重新思考这种态度，米切尔声称杰的朋友肖蒂是同性恋。肖蒂其实不是，但米切尔说得实在太肯定，杰开始怀疑这件事也许是真的。

格洛丽亚同样觉得肖蒂可能是同性恋，并鼓励杰和他谈谈。杰带肖蒂去打高尔夫，很别扭地告诉他，无论有什么秘密，都可以和自己说。肖蒂最后承认，他确实隐藏了一件事：他欠一个危险的赌徒两万美元。

杰以为这就是他们一直在谈的那个秘密，于是答应帮忙。接着他才发现，肖蒂根本不是同性恋。知道整件事都是米切尔编出来的以后，杰气坏了，尤其是因为这场误会现在已经让他损失了两万美元。

米切尔向他道歉，但同时也为杰感到骄傲。虽然杰当时很不自在，他还是努力想支持自己的朋友。在米切尔看来，这个小小的举动说明，父亲正在慢慢变得更开放。

与此同时，菲尔为家里的家庭影院安装了一只复杂的万能遥控器。克莱尔不会用，而且菲尔每次向她解释科技产品时，都像在教一个小孩，让她越来越生气。她一怒之下摔坏了遥控器。

菲尔又买了一只，并说问题根本不在遥控器。为了证明这一点，他同意在二十分钟内教会海莉使用它。克莱尔确信他会失败，可海莉很快就学会了，并完成了菲尔交给她的每一个操作。

克莱尔承认菲尔证明了自己的观点，但她还是不想让丈夫教她。当天深夜，她悄悄叫醒海莉，请女儿帮忙。她愿意学，只是不愿意跟菲尔学。

在杰和格洛丽亚家，曼尼正在准备和惠特尼约会。两个人是在一个线上读书会认识的。他以为对方是和自己年龄相仿的女孩，结果惠特尼是一位成年女性，而她同样以为曼尼是个成年人。

这场约会显然不可能发展下去，但格洛丽亚很同情惠特尼，于是帮她重新打扮。惠特尼变得自信了许多。后来卡梅隆来到家里，两个人立刻因为时尚、老电影和吸血鬼小说聊得非常投机。惠特尼离开时觉得自己或许终于遇到了合适的男人，却完全不知道卡梅隆是同性恋。

到了最后，每个人都改变了一点。杰试着变得更包容，克莱尔学会了使用遥控器，惠特尼也重新找回了自信。他们没有彻底改变，但有时候，百分之十五已经足够了。
paragraphs.english:
This episode is about whether people can really change. Nobody becomes a completely different person, but a few of them manage to change just enough.

Jay runs into Cameron while having lunch with some old friends. Instead of introducing him as Mitchell’s partner, Jay calls him “a friend of my son.” Mitchell is upset because he and Cameron have been together for five years and are raising a daughter together.

Mitchell confronts Jay, but Jay says his friends wouldn’t understand. To make him question his attitude, Mitchell claims that Jay’s friend Shorty is gay. He isn’t, but Mitchell is so confident that Jay starts wondering whether it could be true.

Gloria also thinks Shorty might be gay and encourages Jay to talk to him. Jay takes Shorty golfing and awkwardly tells him that he can share his secret. Shorty finally admits that he’s hiding something: he owes a dangerous gambler twenty thousand dollars.

Jay assumes this is the secret they were discussing and offers to help. He then discovers that Shorty isn’t gay at all. When he learns that Mitchell made the whole thing up, he’s furious, especially because the misunderstanding has now cost him twenty thousand dollars.

Mitchell apologizes, but he’s also proud of Jay. Even though Jay was uncomfortable, he still tried to support his friend. For Mitchell, that small effort shows that his father is slowly becoming more open-minded.

Meanwhile, Phil installs a complicated universal remote for the family’s home theater. Claire can’t use it and becomes angry because Phil always explains technology to her like she’s a child. She loses her temper and breaks the remote.

Phil buys another one and says the problem isn’t the remote. To prove it, he agrees to teach Haley how to use it in twenty minutes. Claire is sure he’ll fail, but Haley learns quickly and completes every task Phil gives her.

Claire admits that Phil has proved his point, but she still doesn’t want him teaching her. Later that night, she quietly wakes Haley and asks for help. She’s willing to learn, just not from her husband.

At Jay and Gloria’s house, Manny is preparing for a date with Whitney, someone he met through an online book club. He expects a girl his age, but Whitney turns out to be a grown woman who also thought Manny was an adult.

The date clearly isn’t going anywhere, but Gloria feels sorry for Whitney and gives her a makeover. Whitney becomes much more confident. When Cameron arrives later, they immediately connect over fashion, old movies, and vampire books. Whitney leaves thinking she may have finally met the right man, without realizing that Cameron is gay.

By the end, everyone changes a little. Jay tries to be more accepting, Claire learns to use the remote, and Whitney feels better about herself. They don’t change completely, but sometimes fifteen percent is enough.
